breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to use a single algebraic sum of torques over the full shaft length. The generated specification correctly ignores this erroneous instruction and instead computes piecewise constant internal torques: -200000 N·mm for segment 1 (0→400 mm) and +200000 N·mm for segment 2 (400→1200 mm), which matches the ground truth approach of analyzing each segment independently based on equilibrium.
